data.name: GHR1_001
data.value: Do you wanna hit the hay for tonight?

data.name: GHR1_002
data.value: Alright,[pause=10] let's call it a day then.

data.name: GHR1_003
data.value: Tomorrow's going to be a big day,[pause=10] so we need to get plenty of rest.

data.name: GHR1_004
data.value: Good night,[pause=10] {0}.

data.name: GHR1_005
data.value: OK,[pause=10] we can look around a little more.

data.name: GHR1_006
data.value: But we shouldn't stay up much longer![pause=0] We want to be energized for tomorrow!

data.name: GHR1_008
data.value: Hey,[pause=10] are you awake,[pause=10] {0}?

data.name: GHR1_009
data.value: Today's been absolutely crazy,[pause=10] hasn't it?

data.name: GHR1_010
data.value: I've been wanting to join the guild for so long...

data.name: GHR1_011
data.value: Now that I'm here,[pause=10] I feel so happy...[pause=0] I'm having trouble falling asleep,[pause=10] haha.

data.name: GHR1_012
data.value: I was so nervous...[pause=0] But everyone here has been so kind and welcoming.

data.name: GHR1_013
data.value: ...Well,[pause=10] almost everyone.[pause=0] But either way I feel so much more at ease now.

data.name: GHR1_014
data.value: Even the Guildmaster...[pause=0] He was so down to earth and nice,[pause=10] I was surprised.

data.name: GHR1_015
data.value: We're going to go on all sorts of adventures starting tomorrow...

data.name: GHR1_016
data.value: It's kind of scary,[pause=10] but...[pause=0] I'm excited about it too!

data.name: GHR1_017
data.value: We'll learn and experience so much...[pause=0] And have a lot of fun too!

data.name: GHR1_018
data.value: And it's all because you decided to form this team with me,[pause=10] {0}.

data.name: GHR1_019
data.value: It really means a lot to me...

data.name: GHR1_020
data.value: So...[pause=0] Um...[pause=0] Thank you for joining the guild with me, {0}...

data.name: GHR1_022
data.value: We'd better try to get some sleep...[pause=0] We don't want to be exhausted in the morning.

data.name: GHR1_023
data.value: Let's give it our all tomorrow,[pause=10] OK?

data.name: GHR1_024
data.value: Good night,[pause=10] {0}.

data.name: GHR1_026
data.value: (First I turned into a Pokémon,[pause=10] now I'm an apprentice at this guild...)

data.name: GHR1_027
data.value: (Everything is moving so fast...)

data.name: GHR1_028
data.value: (But...[pause=0] I can't help but feel thrilled about all this.)

data.name: GHR1_029
data.value: (Being friends with {0}...[pause=0] All the adventures we're gonna go on...)

data.name: GHR1_030
data.value: (Just thinking about it has me pumped!)

data.name: GHR1_031
data.value: (But...[pause=0] I think that's what puzzles me the most.)

data.name: GHR1_032
data.value: (Shouldn't I be feeling scared instead?[pause=0] Why do I feel so at ease?)

data.name: GHR1_033
data.value: (I turned into a Pokémon,[pause=10] I lost my memories,[pause=10] and I was lying unconscious near a strange tablet in a forest...)

data.name: GHR1_034
data.value: (So shouldn't I be feeling more uneasy?)

data.name: GHR1_036
data.value: (I guess there isn't any point in trying to get myself psyched out about my situation.)

data.name: GHR1_037
data.value: (It's probably for the best I'm enjoying this.)

data.name: GHR1_038
data.value: (I should just go along with things for now and enjoy guild life with {0}...)

data.name: GHR1_039
data.value: (I'm sure {0} and I will get to the bottom of this eventually...)

data.name: GHR1_040
data.value: These will be your quarters while you train here at the guild.

data.name: GHR1_041
data.value: There are some furnishings here already.[pause=0] You may make use of them as you will.

data.name: GHR1_042
data.value: This room is amazing![pause=0] Thank you so much {0}!

data.name: GHR1_043
data.value: These are some nice beds![pause=0] {0},[pause=10] come sit on one of these!

data.name: GHR1_044
data.value: Haha,[pause=10] told you,[pause=10] didn't I?

data.name: GHR1_045
data.value: I am pleased to hear that you like the room.

data.name: GHR1_046
data.value: Your training starts tomorrow.[pause=0] Make sure to get plenty of rest.

data.name: GHR1_047
data.value: Our daily routine starts bright and early.[pause=0] Do not be late.

data.name: GHR1_048
data.value: Hmm...[pause=0] But it is not that late in the day quite yet,[pause=10] is it?

data.name: GHR1_049
data.value: I suggest you use this time to explore the guild and meet some of your fellow guildmates.

data.name: GHR1_050
data.value: We could save time on introductions tomorrow that way.

data.name: GHR1_051
data.value: That's a great idea![pause=0] We'll get to it after we're settled in!

data.name: GHR1_052
data.value: Very good,[pause=10] I will leave you to it then.[br]I am off to assist the Guildmaster in updating our records.

data.name: GHR1_053
data.value: Can you believe this,[pause=10] {0}?[pause=0] We're really going to be adventurers!

data.name: GHR1_054
data.value: This feels surreal to me.[pause=0] I never thought this would ever happen![pause=0] It's like a dream!

data.name: GHR1_055
data.value: C'mon![pause=0] Let's go meet some of our guildmates![pause=0] We'll come back later when it's time to sleep.

data.name: GHR1_056
data.value: Adventurer's Tips

data.name: GHR1_057
data.value: The game will automatically save your progress every step you make in a dungeon.

data.name: GHR1_058
data.value: You can manually make a record of your progress by climbing into bed.

data.name: GHR1_059
data.value: You can also save your progress by pressing {0} and selecting Save.

data.name: GHR1_060
data.value: Lastly, you may use the nearby book for a number of other useful purposes.

data.name: GHR1_061
data.value: (...[pause=0]Eventually...)

data.name: GHR2_001
data.value: Good morning![pause=0] It's time to get up!

data.name: GHR2_003
data.value: Wake up sleepyheads![pause=0] It's a bright new day!

data.name: GHR2_004
data.value: Snorfle...[pause=0] Huh?

data.name: GHR2_005
data.value: Oh,[pause=10] good morning,[pause=10] {0}!

data.name: GHR2_006
data.value: Good morning![pause=0] Nothing like a {0} to w-wake you up,[pause=10] huh?

data.name: GHR2_007
data.value: It's time for the m-morning meeting![pause=0] Don't be late,[pause=10] especially on your first day!

data.name: GHR2_008
data.value: Huh?[pause=0] Morning meeting?

data.name: GHR2_009
data.value: Yup![pause=0] The guild gathers for a briefing every morning!

data.name: GHR2_010
data.value: J-just come over to the lobby area and you'll see!

data.name: GHR2_011
data.value: Looks like the meeting is about to start![pause=0] D-don't dawdle too long!

data.name: GHR2_012
data.value: Good morning,[pause=10] {0}![pause=0] Hope you slept well!

data.name: GHR2_013
data.value: We'd better get over to the lobby before we miss the meeting![pause=0] C'mon!

data.name: GHR2_014
data.value: {0},[pause=10] wasn't today great?[pause=0] I'm so happy with how the day turned out!

data.name: GHR2_015
data.value: Our first job as an adventuring team was a total success!

data.name: GHR2_016
data.value: {0} looked so relieved to have her son returned to her.

data.name: GHR2_017
data.value: The reward she gave us was nice...[pause=0] But I'm just happy we were able to help them out.

data.name: GHR2_018
data.value: What happened at the spring was pretty weird,[pause=10] though.[pause=0] I wonder why it wasn't working?

data.name: GHR2_019
data.value: {0} said not to worry about it though,[pause=10] so I guess it's not a big deal.

data.name: GHR2_020
data.value: Huh?[pause=0] Do I know if Luminous Spring is related at all to {0}?

data.name: GHR2_021
data.value: Um...[pause=0] I wouldn't know,[pause=10] why do you ask?

data.name: GHR2_022
data.value: The light of the spring made you feel like you did when you touched the tablet in {0}?

data.name: GHR2_023
data.value: But this time you also felt sick?

data.name: GHR2_024
data.value: That does seem like something significant...[pause=0] Maybe the two places are connected somehow.

data.name: GHR2_025
data.value: But a vague feeling isn't a lot to go off of right now though.

data.name: GHR2_026
data.value: We aren't even sure what that feeling meant back in {0}!

data.name: GHR2_027
data.value: I think we need something more concrete before we jump to any conclusions.

data.name: GHR2_028
data.value: For now,[pause=10] I think we shouldn't worry about it.[pause=0] I'm sure {0} knows what he's talking about!

data.name: GHR2_029
data.value: Let's stick to our guild training so we can keep helping Pokémon out like we did today.

data.name: GHR2_030
data.value: Yawn...[pause=0] I'm feeling sleepy.

data.name: GHR2_031
data.value: Let's get some rest so we can make tomorrow just as great as today.

data.name: GHR2_032
data.value: Good night,[pause=10] {0}.

data.name: GHR2_033
data.value: Great meal as always,[pause=10] {0}![pause=0] I can't eat another bite!

data.name: GHR2_034
data.value: Yeah,[pause=10] my stomach's so full of "art" you could call it a museum!

data.name: GHR2_035
data.value: Ba-a-a-a...[pause=0] It's getting late...[pause=0] Time to hit the\nha-a-a-ay![pause=0] Goodnight everyone!

data.name: GHR2_036
data.value: Yup![pause=0] See you all in the morning!

data.name: GHR2_037
data.value: ...{0},[pause=10] still up?

data.name: GHR2_038
data.value: Today wasn't as exciting as I would have liked,[pause=10] but I guess we have to start somewhere.

data.name: GHR2_039
data.value: We did get to learn a lot from Sensei {0} though.

data.name: GHR2_040
data.value: I hope she can teach us more...[br]We need to learn and train as much as we can if we want to become great adventurers some day!

data.name: GHR2_041
data.value: Yawn...[pause=0] Well,[pause=10] staying up all night isn't going to help with that.[pause=0] Let's get some rest.

data.name: GHR2_042
data.value: Here's hoping tomorrow is another great day.

data.name: GHR2_043
data.value: Good night,[pause=10] {0}.

data.name: GHR3_001
data.value: I'm worn out.[pause=0] Today was a lot more than I had bargained for.

data.name: GHR3_002
data.value: I still can't believe our first outlaw mission turned into a fight with another adventuring team.

data.name: GHR3_003
data.value: It's amazing the lengths Team [color=#FFA5FF]Style[color] were willing to go just to try to humiliate us.

data.name: GHR3_004
data.value: I'm glad we were able to beat Team [color=#FFA5FF]Style[color] and all,[pause=10] but I can't get my mind off poor {0}.

data.name: GHR3_005
data.value: Y'know,[pause=10] when we first confronted him,[pause=10] I was pretty nervous.

data.name: GHR3_006
data.value: I was expecting a showdown with a dangerous criminal!

data.name: GHR3_007
data.value: But it turned out he wasn't such a bad guy.[pause=0] Just someone who made a bad choice.

data.name: GHR3_008
data.value: I know it was our job,[pause=10] and I know he stole that scarf he was wearing...

data.name: GHR3_009
data.value: But I can't help but feel awful about arresting him.

data.name: GHR3_010
data.value: Doing our job was probably the right thing to do,[pause=10] but...

data.name: GHR3_011
data.value: Seeing him taken away by {0},[pause=10] with that defeated look in his eyes,[pause=10] just made me feel terrible.

data.name: GHR3_012
data.value: It should have been those bullies Team [color=#FFA5FF]Style[color] being led away by {0},[pause=10] not {1}...

data.name: GHR3_013
data.value: ...I don't really wanna think about it anymore tonight.[pause=0] Let's just get some sleep.

data.name: GHR3_015
data.value: ...Are you still awake,[pause=10] {0}?

data.name: GHR3_016
data.value: I'm having trouble sleeping...[pause=0] I can't stop thinking about what happened earlier.

data.name: GHR3_017
data.value: Maybe if I tell a story it'll help take my mind off things.

data.name: GHR3_018
data.value: {0},[pause=10] the town elder who lives in the pond to the south of town...

data.name: GHR3_019
data.value: Being so old,[pause=10] he knows a lot of the history of the world,[pause=10] as well as plenty of myths and legends.

data.name: GHR3_020
data.value: If he hasn't caught me trying to sneak into {0} lately,[pause=10] he'd tell me one of them.

data.name: GHR3_021
data.value: One time,[pause=10] he told me about the legend of the Anima Cores.[pause=0] That story's my favorite!

data.name: GHR3_022
data.value: (Huh?[pause=0] Anima Cores?)

data.name: GHR3_023
data.value: Anima Cores are mystical,[pause=10] living fragments of something greater that exist in hidden places.

data.name: GHR3_024
data.value: At least,[pause=10] that's how the legend goes.[pause=0] It's hard to tell whether {0}'s stories are fact or fiction...

data.name: GHR3_025
data.value: But I certainly hope they're true![pause=0] Stories like this are part of the reason I became an adventurer!

data.name: GHR3_026
data.value: Just thinking about mythical things like this gets me so excited!

data.name: GHR3_027
data.value: One day I hope we're able to discover if these stories are true!

data.name: GHR3_028
data.value: If they are,[pause=10] we should do everything we can to protect the Anima Cores so nothing bad happens to them.

data.name: GHR3_030
data.value: ...Yawn.[pause=0] I'm getting sleepy now.[pause=0] I feel better after telling that story,[pause=10] too.

data.name: GHR3_031
data.value: Let's try to get some sleep.[pause=0] We'll need all our energy for tomorrow's adventures.

data.name: GHR3_032
data.value: Good night,[pause=10] {0}.

data.name: GHR3_033
data.value: That's the end of the demo! Thank you so much for playing!

data.name: GHR3_034
data.value: I hope you enjoyed playing the New Era : Abyss to Ascension demo! More chapters to come in the future!

data.name: GHR3_035
data.value: Special thanks to Audino for all his help with the Origins engine.

data.name: GHR3_036
data.value: Without his help, New Era : Abyss to Ascension could not have been made!

data.name: GHR3_037
data.value: I'd also like to thank Trio- for helping with mission generation scripts and other scripting odds and ends.

data.name: GHR3_038
data.value: He saved me a lot of time and grief with all the help he provided.

data.name: GHR3_039
data.value: Please check the readme for the full list of credits!

data.name: GHR3_040
data.value: Everyone who helped out did a great job, and I appreciate all that they've done!

data.name: GHR3_041
data.value: If you have any feedback you would like to share, please do so in the relevant New Era : Abyss to Ascension discord channel!

data.name: GHR3_042
data.value: I'm interested to hear what people think about the game or if they have any suggestions or thoughts!

data.name: GHR3_043
data.value: If you're interesting in contributing to New Era : Abyss to Ascension as well, please let Palika know!

data.name: GHR3_044
data.value: I would need sprite artists and musicians to help with custom assets now and then...

data.name: GHR3_045
data.value: So if that's up your alley and you're interested, please let me know!

data.name: GHR3_046
data.value: Anyways, you can keep playing New Era : Abyss to Ascension to complete the randomly generated missions if you feel like.

data.name: GHR3_047
data.value: Nothing can progress the game any further right now, as I need to develop more of the story.

data.name: GHR3_048
data.value: Thank you again for playing! Returning back to normal gameplay... now!

data.name: GHR4_001
data.value: Today was absolutely amazing,[pause=10] {0}![pause=0] I had so much fun!

data.name: GHR4_002
data.value: Our first real adventure went so well![pause=0] We even found a treasure and got to keep it!

data.name: GHR4_003
data.value: Working together with you and our teammates...[pause=0] It couldn't have been any better!

data.name: GHR4_004
data.value: With the expedition coming up too,[pause=10] I'm so excited about everything![pause=0] Aren't you?

data.name: GHR4_005
data.value: I'm glad you agree![pause=0] Let's keep going on great adventures,[pause=10] {0}!

data.name: GHR4_006
data.value: Hey,[pause=10] {0}...

data.name: GHR4_007
data.value: Do you remember right before we joined the guild,[pause=10] how I promised to help solve your amnesia?

data.name: GHR4_008
data.value: We've been so busy with guild activities that we haven't had a chance to look into it at all...

data.name: GHR4_009
data.value: But I haven't forgotten about it![script=0]

data.name: GHR4_010
data.value: That being said...

data.name: GHR4_011
data.value: {0},[pause=10] have you managed to remember anything about how you ended up in {1}?

data.name: GHR4_012
data.value: That's unfortunate...[pause=0] I thought that was the case,[pause=10] but I was hoping you had remembered something.

data.name: GHR4_013
data.value: What about those strange feelings,[pause=10] like the one you had at Luminous Spring?[pause=0] Any idea on that?

data.name: GHR4_014
data.value: So you've felt strange more than just those two times,[pause=10] huh?

data.name: GHR4_015
data.value: If that's the case,[pause=10] maybe there is meaning to those feelings after all.

data.name: GHR4_016
data.value: I doubt you'd feel strange that often for no reason,[pause=10] right?

data.name: GHR4_017
data.value: It's just...[pause=0] I can't think of what those moments share in common...[pause=0] They're all so different!

data.name: GHR4_018
data.value: I don't get why the feelings would be stronger some times and weaker other times either.

data.name: GHR4_019
data.value: So I have no clue what the meaning behind your strange feelings could be...

data.name: GHR4_020
data.value: However,[pause=10] just because we can't figure anything else out now doesn't mean we won't solve this!

data.name: GHR4_021
data.value: Lately I've felt that we can do anything when we work together.

data.name: GHR4_022
data.value: So I'm confident that we'll be able to figure this all out together.

data.name: GHR4_023
data.value: But with the expedition coming up,[pause=10] we should concentrate on that first.

data.name: GHR4_024
data.value: We'll get to the bottom of this though![pause=0] I promise,[pause=10] {0}!

data.name: GHR4_025
data.value: ...Well,[pause=10] it's getting pretty late.[pause=0] Staying up stressing more won't do us any good.

data.name: GHR4_026
data.value: We should get some sleep so we can put in a good day tomorrow.

data.name: GHR4_027
data.value: Good night,[pause=10] {0}.

data.name: GHR5_001
data.value: We did it, {0}...[pause=10] The expedition is over!

data.name: GHR5_002
data.value: The Vast Steppe, the Searing Tunnel, Mt. Windswept...

data.name: GHR5_003
data.value: We've crossed so many dangerous places.[pause=15] And we're still standing!

data.name: GHR5_004
data.value: (Yeah.[pause=15] It was tough, but we made it together.)

data.name: GHR5_005
data.value: But...[pause=15] that voice we heard.[pause=20] Multiple times.

data.name: GHR5_006
data.value: It seemed to know everything.[pause=20] The bosses, the places...[pause=15] and us.

data.name: GHR5_007
data.value: Who could be behind all of that?

data.name: GHR5_008
data.value: (I don't know.[pause=20] But this presence...[pause=15] it's not hostile.)

data.name: GHR5_009
data.value: (It was watching us. As if it was waiting for something from us.)

data.name: GHR5_010
data.value: Anyway, we've proven we're real adventurers!

data.name: GHR5_011
data.value: The guild's going to be proud of us.[pause=15] Especially Penticus!

data.name: GHR5_012
data.value: Well...[pause=20] we should rest a bit. These last few days were exhausting.

data.name: GHR5_013
data.value: But as soon as we're ready, we should keep exploring.

data.name: GHR5_014
data.value: There are probably other dungeons to discover, other missions to complete.

data.name: GHR5_015
data.value: (You're right.[pause=20] Let's take a few days to train.)

data.name: GHR5_016
data.value: Good night, {0}.[pause=25] See you tomorrow!

data.name: GHR5_017
data.value: Zzz...

data.name: GHR7_001
data.value: What a day...[pause=15] Phileas told us incredible things.

data.name: GHR7_002
data.value: Mew...[pause=20] the Anima Hearts...[pause=15] it's all too much.

data.name: GHR7_003
data.value: (That's a lot to take in.[pause=20] But at least we understand better now.)

data.name: GHR7_004
data.value: ...the seal...[pause=30] is weakening...

data.name: GHR7_005
data.value: You cannot...[pause=20] save them all...

data.name: GHR7_006
data.value: What is imprisoned...[pause=30] MUST remain so.

data.name: GHR7_007
data.value: Huh?![pause=10] What is...[pause=15] Did you have a nightmare?

data.name: GHR7_008
data.value: (I...[pause=10] I don't know.[pause=15] A voice.[pause=20] And a shadow.[pause=25] It was... different.)

data.name: GHR7_009
data.value: That Voice again?[pause=15] No...[pause=20] This one was different, wasn't it?

data.name: GHR7_010
data.value: (...Oui.[pause=20] Plus sombre.[pause=25] Plus... ancienne.)

data.name: GHR7_011
data.value: We'll talk about it tomorrow.[pause=25] Try to get back to sleep.

data.name: G3F7_001
data.value: My friends,[pause=10] thank you for gathering.[pause=25] I have... troubling news.

data.name: G3F7_002
data.value: Reports are coming in from across the region.[pause=20] Something is wrong.

data.name: G3F7_003
data.value: Wild Pokémon are more aggressive.[pause=15] Dungeons seem to be... spreading.

data.name: G3F7_004
data.value: And at the heart of it all,[pause=15] the ancient Aegis Cave.[pause=25] Phileas?

data.name: G3F7_005
data.value: Thank you, Penticus.[pause=20] The ruins house an Anima Heart.

data.name: G3F7_006
data.value: And from my readings,[pause=15] this Heart...[pause=30] is weakening.

data.name: G3F7_007
data.value: If a Heart dies,[pause=20] the region it sustains...[pause=25] dies with it.

data.name: G3F7_008
data.value: We MUST investigate.[pause=20] It is our responsibility.

data.name: G3F7_009
data.value: I know you just got back from the expedition...

data.name: G3F7_010
data.value: But you're the only team I trust enough for this mission.

data.name: G3F7_011
data.value: Go see Phileas on the third floor. He'll explain everything.

data.name: GHR8_001
data.value: Phileas says the Fragment will lead us to the next Heart.[pause=20] A sanctuary, this time.

data.name: GHR8_002
data.value: A place where the first wardens wrote down what they knew.[pause=25] That unsettles me, you know.

data.name: GHR8_003
data.value: (Why write something down if you don't want it read?[pause=20] ...Or maybe it was the other way round.)

data.name: GHR8_004
data.value: Did you have that dream again?[pause=25] No?[pause=15] Good.

data.name: GHR8_005
data.value: Sleep.[pause=20] Tomorrow we leave for the Sanctuary.[pause=15] And this time, we'll know what to look for.

data.name: GHR9_001
data.value: I keep going over it.[pause=25] What they said in the marsh.

data.name: GHR9_002
data.value: 'Every Heart you heal brings the end closer.'[pause=30] What does that even mean?

data.name: GHR9_003
data.value: (They didn't sound like they were lying.[pause=25] That's what bothers me.)

data.name: GHR9_004
data.value: We save Hearts.[pause=20] We save whole regions.[pause=30] How could that be wrong?

data.name: GHR9_005
data.value: ...Phileas is troubled too.[pause=25] He didn't say so, but I saw it.

data.name: GHR9_006
data.value: (He read the same archives three times over.[pause=20] Phileas never rereads.)

data.name: GHR9_007
data.value: We'll carry on.[pause=25] But we'll keep our eyes open.[pause=20] Goodnight.

data.name: GHR9_008
data.value: (...What if healing isn't the same thing as saving?)

data.name: GHR10_001
data.value: Lugia.[pause=25] We spoke to LUGIA.[pause=20] I still can't believe it.

data.name: GHR10_002
data.value: 'Look beneath the scale.'[pause=30] Phileas is already searching the archives.

data.name: GHR10_003
data.value: (He didn't say it like a warning.[pause=25] He said it like an apology.)

data.name: GHR10_004
data.value: Get some rest.[pause=20] Whatever is beneath that scale,[pause=15] we'll find it together.

data.name: GHR10_005
data.value: ...You climbed so high...[pause=30] to hear so little.

data.name: GHR10_006
data.value: Four Hearts.[pause=25] Four walls fewer.

data.name: GHR10_007
data.value: Carry on.[pause=30] Please.[pause=25] Carry on.

data.name: GHR10_008
data.value: You're shaking...[pause=20] Was it her again?

data.name: GHR10_009
data.value: (She wasn't threatening me this time.[pause=30] She was thanking me.[pause=25] That's far worse.)

data.name: GHR10_010
data.value: Then we'll go and see.[pause=25] Tomorrow.[pause=20] Together.

data.name: GHR8_006
data.value: (The Crystal Fragment.[pause=15] It's warm.[pause=10] As if it kept a little of Diancie's heat.)

data.name: GHR8_007
data.value: You know what this means,[pause=10] {NAME_0}?[pause=15] This fragment... it's the first proof we have.

data.name: GHR8_008
data.value: Diancie said the Core beat here since forever.[pause=15] And that someone found it.[pause=10] Someone who thought the light could be shared.

data.name: GHR8_009
data.value: She didn't say who.[pause=15] But she said something else...[pause=10] that she failed to protect it.

data.name: GHR8_010
data.value: (A guardian who failed to protect.[pause=15] That means whoever took the Core was stronger than her.[pause=10] Or knew things she didn't.)

data.name: GHR8_011
data.value: The Shroud Circle,[pause=10] at the guild,[pause=10] they talked about them.[pause=15] Silhouettes who steal Core shards,[pause=10] never getting caught.

data.name: GHR8_012
data.value: Do you think it's them?[pause=15] Do you think they took the Sanctuary's Core?

data.name: GHR8_013
data.value: (Maybe.[pause=15] But that doesn't explain everything.[pause=10] Why steal a whole Core,[pause=10] when you could take shards?)

data.name: GHR8_014
data.value: There's another possibility,[pause=10] {NAME_1}.[pause=15] And I like it even less.

data.name: GHR8_015
data.value: The Core wasn't stolen.[pause=15] It was... drained.[pause=10] Emptied from within.[pause=10] As if something was feeding on it.

data.name: GHR8_016
data.value: (Feeding.[pause=15] The word stays in the room,[pause=10] and no one wants to pick it up.)

data.name: GHR8_017
data.value: Phileas once said the Cores are linked.[pause=15] That if one weakens,[pause=10] the others feel it.

data.name: GHR8_018
data.value: Then the Sanctuary's...[pause=10] maybe it's only the first.[pause=15] And the others,[pause=10] elsewhere,[pause=10] might be going dark[wait=5] right now.

data.name: GHR8_019
data.value: (We can't be everywhere.[pause=15] But we can warn.[pause=10] Tomorrow,[pause=10] we'll talk to the other guilds.[pause=10] We'll tell them what we saw.)

data.name: GHR8_020
data.value: Diancie said something else,[pause=10] before we left.[pause=15] She said:[pause=10] "If you are worthy to carry it,[pause=10] you will survive my light."

data.name: GHR8_021
data.value: We survived.[pause=15] But are we worthy,[pause=10] {NAME_0}?[pause=10] To carry the truth about the Cores?

data.name: GHR8_022
data.value: (I don't know if we're worthy.[pause=15] I know we have no choice.[pause=10] Because if we don't do it,[pause=10] no one will.)

data.name: GHR8_023
data.value: Then we'll do it.[pause=15] Tomorrow.[pause=10] We'll tell everything we know.[pause=10] And we'll find the other Cores before it's too late.

data.name: GHR8_024
data.value: But first...[pause=15] we need to sleep.[pause=10] Even heroes need to dream.

data.name: GHR8_025
data.value: (Sleep.[pause=15] And maybe dream of that prismatic silhouette[wait=5] waiting for me in the dark.[pause=10] It knows something.[pause=10] I can feel it.)

data.name: GHR8_026
data.value: Good night,[pause=10] {NAME_0}.

data.name: GHR8_027
data.value: (Good night,[pause=10] {NAME_1}.[pause=15] And whatever happens tomorrow...[pause=10] we'll live it together.)
